title: Operations New Bulk Email Entry Permission Consistency

items.action: open and select generic operation creation entries
open and select the Bulk Email new-operation entry

backend.reason: Bulk Email immediate create/start authorization already uses fair_crm.fair_emails.execute.

api.reason: No API contract changes; wizard metadata and operation-type reads already use existing read access.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The Bulk Email wizard route already uses fair_crm.fair_emails.execute; this change aligns the Operations-page entry point.

forms.reason: No business form behavior changes; the type picker only filters unauthorized operation types.

notes: A user with fair_crm.fair_emails.execute can reach the Bulk Email wizard from /operations without also needing fair_crm.operations.create. Generic operation entries continue to require fair_crm.operations.create. Enrichment and Scraper new-operation entry alignment remain intentionally outside this focused change. The type picker filters entries through the same fail-closed permission predicate used by onContinue.
